items.title: Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2022
items.q: Yeah in that group, Mike was in that group too, the guitar player that played last night.

ctx.x: Tiny’s there we go. Yeah in that group, Mike was in that group too, the guitar player that played last night. And that was an interesting band because you know it was like a far cry away from anything I had really done. So I had to kind of discipline myself to really play parts. And there was a lot of complicated music in that.
